items.q: Does my homeowners insurance cover my home business?
items.a: Almost certainly not. Most homeowners policies specifically exclude business activities, equipment, and liability.

items.q: I just sell on Etsy — do I really need insurance?
items.a: If a customer claims your product injured them, your homeowners policy won't help. Even small sellers face real liability.

items.q: How much does home business insurance cost?
items.a: Many home business policies start under $500/year. I'll compare options to find the most affordable coverage for your situation.

items.q: Can I bundle this with my homeowners policy?
items.a: Sometimes, yes. Some carriers offer endorsements that add business coverage to your existing homeowners policy, which can save money.
